title: Project (v2, superseded — migration source only, see project-v3.schema.json)
description: SUPERSEDED by project-v3.schema.json (schemaVersion 3, round-2 §3.3/§5) — kept here as the MIGRATION SOURCE format, not deleted: src-tauri/src/midi/persist.rs::parse_clips_legacy reads this shape forever (an un-resaved v2 project must keep loading), and v2->v3 is a mechanical in-memory upgrade on first save (period-quantize tempoMap once, default meterMap to [{0,4,4}], split each midiClips row into a content[]+placements[]+lanes[] triple). Do not describe NEW writes against this document — see project-v3.schema.json for what persist.rs actually writes today. // Original v2 description follows — project.json format version 2 — v1 (project.schema.json) plus musical time (debt D-02 paydown): ppq + tempoMap in ticks, MIDI clips with binary AMEV event chunks, and sampler instrument references. ADDITIVE evolution: every v1 field keeps its exact v1 meaning; audio clip positions stay sample-based. Migration v1->v2 is mechanical: set schemaVersion=2, ppq=960, tempoMap=[{tick:0,bpm:<tempoBpm>}], midiClips=[], instruments=[]. tempoBpm is retained and MUST equal tempoMap[0].bpm (older tooling reads it). Per debt D-06, v2 schemas are emitter contracts WITHOUT additionalProperties:false — readers ignore unknown fields.

schemaVersion.description: project.json format version; this document describes version 2.

tempoBpm.description: Legacy single tempo, kept for older tooling; MUST equal tempoMap[0].bpm.

ppq.description: Ticks per quarter note for ALL tick-valued fields in this file.

tempoMap.description: Sorted tempo changes; first entry MUST be at tick 0. A one-entry map is exactly v1 semantics.

tracks.description: track-state.schema.json objects; v2 adds kind:"midi" and the optional instrumentId field (sampler-instrument.schema.json id) on midi tracks.

clips.description: Audio clips, unchanged from v1 (clip.schema.json, sample-based).

midiClips.description: MIDI clip placements (ticks). Note payloads live in AMEV chunk files referenced by eventsRef — NEVER inline in project.json (SCALABILITY §3).

instruments.description: Sampler instruments used by midi tracks.
